title: Hurricane
tldr: Check your evacuation zone and the current order. If told to evacuate, leave before conditions deteriorate. If staying outside an evacuation zone, shelter inside a sturdy building away from windows; storm surge and inland flooding can be deadly even far from the storm center.
steps: Read local evacuation and storm-surge instructions for your address, not just the forecast track.
Use official routes to a destination outside the hazard area. Bring medications, identification, pets and phone power.
If the building is safe and evacuation is not required, stay in an interior room away from windows during strong winds.
Keep out of flooded roads and basements. Follow separate flash-flood warnings and move to safer higher ground when necessary.
next: Expect extended outages. Store water, protect documents and charge devices before the storm. Return only after officials allow reentry.
watch: A calm eye is not an all-clear. Do not base flood safety on the wind category.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Before roads become unsafe, move out of surge-prone areas using a route and destination you have checked. If already trapped by wind or water, stay in the safest intact interior space available, with flood risk in mind. Do not travel during the calm eye.
household: Account for children, older people, pets and anyone who needs assistance before moving. Keep shoes, medicines and a torch in the shelter area. Decide who helps whom and who carries the essential supplies; do not send a lone child to retrieve items. For this situation, brief every person on the first action: check your zone. Agree who will manage children, pets or mobility needs while that action happens. A calm eye is not an all-clear. Do not base flood safety on the wind category.

If already trapped by wind or water, stay in the safest intact interior space available, with flood risk in mind. Do not travel during the calm eye. Keep the relevant checklist and contact information within reach. Equipment retrieval must not delay the protective step.
scope: Civilian educational guidance. Linked references may use U.S. emergency systems; local warning methods, laws, services and conditions differ.
